variants.headline: Ordered goods reach the dock
variants.body: The company {company} has received its imported order of {good} at the port. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: An order completes its long journey
variants.body: Imported {good} ordered by {company} has landed at the colony's port. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Imports landed and paid for
